title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
description: Lemon and oregano flavor tender sheet-pan chicken and potatoes, finished with a thick pan gravy.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 375°F on conventional Bake; place a rack in the center.

steps.title: Mix the braising liquid
steps.text: In a deep rimmed roasting pan, whisk {oil}, the zest and juice of {lemons}, {garlic}, {oregano}, {salt}, {pepper} and {broth}.

steps.title: Arrange the chicken
steps.text: Nestle {chicken} and {potatoes} in the liquid in a single layer. Seal the pan with foil.

steps.title: Braise the thighs
steps.text: Braise for 30–42 minutes, checking at 25 minutes. Lift each thigh into a covered bowl when its center reaches 175°F. Keep cooking any firm potatoes until easily pierced.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Transfer the potatoes to the bowl. Pour the braising liquid into the HexClad and bring to a simmer. Stir {starch} into {cold}, then whisk into the hot liquid and simmer for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Slice the thighs across the grain and coat the chicken and potatoes with the hot gravy.

notes: Make ahead: Refrigerate the cooked chicken submerged in gravy within 2 hours. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, the gravy protects the chicken; the potatoes may soften. Freeze in portions for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: warm covered in a skillet with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the refrigerator, then reheat covered to 165°F. Reflux Option A uses lemon zest and juice. For gentler Option B, use the zest alone. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 308 kcal, 31.1 g protein, 23.8 g total carbohydrate, 9.3 g fat, 2.6 g fiber, 229 mg sodium. Based on the measured ingredients; brands and optional additions can change these values.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 350°F, Sous Vide OFF, rear element only, 50% steam. Insert the probe into the center of the thickest thigh before covering and set it to 175°F.
